titulo: What VAR CAN'T review (it only steps in for 4 things) #shorts
descripcion:
VAR can only step in for four categories (goals, penalties, direct red cards and mistaken identity), and only for a clear and obvious error. Players can't request it, and the final decision always belongs to the referee.

Source: VAR protocol, Laws of the Game 2026/27 (The IFAB), via https://futbolatlas.app/k/var-misconceptions
